brief: Apply the loading reduction specified in MG-021 from the third day onward, as this unit is experiencing an event extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees [MG-021, MG-025]. Consider emergency load transfer in accordance with ERP-032 if the unit approaches its temperature limit, confirming the receiving asset's available capacity with MG-021 applied and verifying its condition [ERP-032].
